latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of bailian-web-search-hardened skill.
- Provides AI-optimized, multi-sourced web search results using the Bailian (Alibaba ModelStdio) API.
- Includes strict security guardrails to protect user privacy and API credentials.
- Search script supports specifying query and result count (default 5, max 20).
- Usage requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY and system tools: bash, curl, jq.
